author: Zintenka
body:
I've decided... that I will not abandon Avicus. I tried, but it kept calling me back because Avicus has become a part of me... despite all its flaws... its still my home...

Anyways, to make it up to Avicus, I've forged up a map for it :) A very beautiful one with enchanting and villager trades. And... a lot of TNT!

Well here it is!


Features:
  • TNT
  • Villager Trading
  • 1.8 enchanting
  • Item attributes
  • Beautiful scenery
  • 4 monuments for each team
For the preparation of Avicus potentially switching to XML, I will post up an XML for it soon.

YML

XML (Soon)

Imgur

Download

Changelog v1.0
  • Updated YML
  • Got rid of 2 villagers
  • 2 Lapis block in inventory
  • 3 dispensers for each kill
  • exp bottles in inventory
